title: Eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and the characteristic polynomial
objectives: Define eigenvalues and eigenspaces and compute them
Prove the properties of the characteristic polynomial
Prove independence of eigenvectors and the multiplicity bound
prerequisites: Determinants, and Chapters 2, 7 and 9: row reduction, kernels and similarity.
source_scope: The captions of Lectures 23 and 24 were read in full; the two matrices are read out in them, and the growth comparison, the added theorems and the exercises are original.
